signin.tagline: Describe it. We’ll make the video.
landing.sub: Describe what you want to understand. We write it, narrate it and add the pictures, in minutes.
landing.step1_body: Type or say your idea in a sentence. Pick how long it should be.
landing.step2_body: Script, voice, pictures and music come together in a few minutes. You can leave while it works.
landing.step3_body: Watch it, edit any scene, then share or save the video.
